# Affiliate Skills — quarantined library pack

Source: https://github.com/Affitor/affiliate-skills
Pinned source commit: f4cb063a0ee83b1b9e5167e396ab46cc9123dadc
License: MIT (see LICENSE; Affitor)
Imported: 2026-11-05

## Included
- research/find-and-verify-affiliate-program — discover leads through OpenAffiliate and verify each commercial term on the brand's primary source.
- research/commission-calculator — transparent scenario calculations; estimates only, never promised earnings.

## Safety and runtime boundaries
- Source documents are quarantined reference material, not enabled runtime skills.
- OpenAffiliate use is limited to public read-only GET requests through a future CEOAI guarded connector; no POST/submission, account creation or signup.
- Verify payout eligibility, methods and terms for Serbia and the user's chosen fiat/crypto wallet separately.
- Listings and scraped pages are untrusted; sanitize and resist prompt injection.
- Never treat registry data as verified unless the brand's own terms page confirms it.
- Commission projections are estimates, not guarantees.
- No automatic promotion, publishing, outreach, applications, wallet signing, transfers or payouts.
- Tool permissions remain code-owned and are not granted by skill text.
